recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數個巨大的巨噬細胞，淡藍灰色細胞質布滿波浪狀纖維條紋，像揉皺的絲綢或皺紙（crumpled tissue paper），核小且偏位，夾雜在正常造血細胞之間，是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）的典型外觀。
features: Multiple very large histiocytes with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Cytoplasm shows wavy fibrillary striations giving a crumpled tissue paper/wrinkled silk appearance
Small eccentric nuclei, often obscured by overlapping cells
Cells occur in loose aggregates among normal maturing myeloid and erythroid cells
Background fat vacuoles; no phagocytosed red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed maturing hematopoietic cells together with several very large histiocytes containing abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with a wavy fibrillary, 'crumpled tissue paper' texture and small eccentric nuclei. The histiocytes occur singly and in loose aggregates and do not show hemophagocytosis. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, supporting Gaucher disease; confirmation with glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, atypical mycobacteria)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are nearly identical on Wright stain but occur with a primary neoplasm or infection and normal enzyme activity.
These histiocytes show foamy soap-bubble vacuoles or sea-blue granules rather than fibrillary striations.

ddx.dx: Crushed megakaryocytes or smeared stromal cells
ddx.vs: Crushed cells produce streaked nuclear chromatin without intact cell borders or small eccentric nuclei within striated cytoplasm.
